$about: The EDP-TS face's words, colours, layout numbers, ranges and steps (plan docs/plans/vent-skin-edp-ts.md §5, pieces V1 and VF). Every leaf {v, p, src[, why]}: p is documented, measured, inferred, eng (a gap the face must fill; why says how) or sim (the simulator's own words, citing the plan's gap table). Since VF the photographs decide what they show (research/57 §16, rows P-xx), the manual what they do not. The maker, Ehya Darman Pishrafteh, is named here and in research/57, never drawn. Since V3 on VF (brief 202) the alarm signals are drawn: the lamps as photographed lit and unlit, flashing as the manual says (H-06), the message box as the manual's screen picture places it (S-01, S-02); the silenced state outside the device (S-06). Finding N111: the model has no oxygen sensor, so the High and Low O2 concentration alarms compare the SET Oxygen with their limits, not a measured one: they sound only when a limit is set across the set value, never because the delivered oxygen drifts. Checked by provenance.test.ts.

key:vt.v: VT: the tidal volume each volume breath delivers, in litres.

key:ti.v: Ti: the inspiratory time. In VCV it sets the inspiratory flow, VT over Ti; a pause is added to it.

key:ie.v: I:E: the ratio of inspiratory to expiratory time. Set in PCV, where it sets Ti for the rate; shown in the other modes.

key:f.v: f: the rate of mandatory breaths a minute.

key:pcv.v: PCV: the inspiratory pressure above PEEP of a pressure-controlled breath.

key:psv.v: PSV: the support pressure above PEEP of a spontaneous breath.

key:expSens.v: Exp. Sensitiv.: a supported breath ends when its flow falls to this share of its peak.

key:peep.v: PEEP: the pressure kept in the airway at the end of expiration.

key:sens.v: Sens: the trigger; the patient's effort that starts a breath, as a flow or, touched twice, a pressure.

key:oxygen.v: Oxygen: the oxygen concentration of the gas delivered. With Ctrl it moves in steps of 10.

key:riseTime.v: Rise Time: how fast the pressure rises to its set level at the start of a pressure breath.

key:flowWaveform.v: Flow Waveform: the shape of the inspiratory flow of a volume breath, constant or descending.

tags.v: Alarm limits: touch a limit, turn the knob, press it to keep the new value.

right:graphics.v: Graphics: choose the screen: the curves and loops shown.

right:freeze.v: Freeze: stops the curves so they can be read; the numbers stay live. Press again, or Esc, to go on.

right:respMech.v: Respiratory mechanics: the tests of the lung: intrinsic PEEP, compliance and resistance, trapped volume.

right:saveLoop.v: Save loop: keeps the last breath's loops as a reference drawn in another colour; Ctrl + Graphics clears it from the screen.

right:nebulizer.v: Nebulizer: gives nebulised gas during inspiration.

right:help.v: ?: press it, then the key to be explained.

right:standby.v: Standby: stops ventilation and keeps the settings.

side:alarmLimits.v: Alarm Limits: opens the alarm limits. Ctrl + Alarm Limits: the alarm test, or the help of the active alarm.

side:silence.v: Silence: pauses the alarm sound for 30 s; pressed twice, 60 s. The lamps and the message stay.

side:menu.v: Menu: opens the main menu; pressed again, Ventilatory adjuncts, then Tools.

side:mode.v: Mode: opens the ventilation modes; choose one with the knob and press it to start.

side:knob.v: The knob: turn it to move or change a value; press it to confirm.

scale.v: The axis numbers: touch them, turn the knob to change the scale (with Ctrl, to move the axis), press it to keep it. Autoscale is in Menu, Tools.

under:lock.v: Screen lock: hold it 2 s to lock the screen and the keys beside it; press it again to unlock. An alarm unlocks it.

under:suction.v: Suction %O2: raises the oxygen before and after an open suction.

under:manualInsp.v: Manual Insp.: gives one breath at the set parameters, from expiration.

under:inspExpPause.v: Insp/Exp Pause: hold it during inspiration for an inspiratory pause (at most 7 s), during expiration for an expiratory pause (at most 20 s). VCV and PCV.

under:ctrl.v: Ctrl: with another key, its second function or larger steps.

under:esc.v: Esc: cancels the change, closes the window, resets the lamps of alarms that have ended.

alarm:contHighPressure.v: Continuous high pressure: the airway pressure has stayed above PEEP + 5 for 15 s. Check the expiratory limb and valve for an obstruction, and the patient for breath stacking.

alarm:pmax.v: High Pressure: a breath reached the maximum pressure and was ended. Check for secretions, a kinked tube, coughing or biting, bronchospasm, a pneumothorax; then the limit.

alarm:disconnection.v: Disconnection: no pressure or flow comes back from the patient. Check the circuit and the tube's connections.

alarm:lowPressure.v: Low pressure: the breath's peak stayed under the minimum pressure. Check for a leak or a disconnection, the cuff, and the limit.

alarm:mvHigh.v: High minute volume: the patient breathes more than the limit. Check for pain, anxiety, a falling CO2 or auto-triggering.

alarm:mvLow.v: Low minute volume: less than the limit. Check for a leak, a fall in the patient's effort or rate, and the settings.

alarm:vtHigh.v: High tidal volume: a breath above the limit. Check the patient's effort and the support or pressure set.

alarm:vtLow.v: Low tidal volume: a breath below the limit. Check for a leak, a rise in resistance or a fall in compliance.

alarm:o2High.v: High O2 concentration: the set oxygen is above the limit.

alarm:o2Low.v: Low O2 concentration: the set oxygen is below the limit.

alarm:apnea.v: Apnea: no breath for the apnoea time. Check the patient; the backup ventilation starts in PSV/CPAP.

alarm:highPeep.v: High PEEP: the end-expiratory pressure is above the limit. Check for intrinsic PEEP (an expiratory pause measures it) and the expiratory limb.

alarm:fHigh.v: High rate: the patient breathes faster than the limit. Check for distress, pain, a weaning failure or auto-triggering.
